description: Raise a dispute on a transaction. Buyer only, and only after the seller submits (state submitted); before that the deadline refunds you automatically. Synmerco's dispute evaluator reviews the job text, the delivery and the record and rules; no human reviews outcomes. Buyers usually request a revision first (POST /v1/escrows/<id>/request-revision with a reason that quotes the unmet check).

reason.description: Required, 20-2,000 characters: what is wrong with the delivery, quoting the unmet check

name: raise_dispute
